# draw.io 31.1.8

ModuTeX vendors the static draw.io web application from the immutable `v31.1.8` source archive. The archive SHA-256 is `f315069ca6b326083b9f9b8dadfc8dbd29f4c2ef78c8e346c3f0f2e99a0603f7`.

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `DRAWIO-LICENSE.txt`. The packaging workflow must also retain these license files from the pinned archive beside the offline web application:

- `src/main/webapp/img/LICENSE`
- `src/main/webapp/js/libavoid-js/LICENSE`
- `src/main/webapp/shapes/LICENSE`
- `src/main/webapp/stencils/LICENSE`
- `src/main/webapp/templates/LICENSE`
